Maintain refined anatomy, slim proportions, a readable single two-legged stance, full body and both complete boots on the floor. Reframe very slightly smaller only if needed for clear blank gray space around all hair, magic, blade tips, coat tails and feet. 1024x1536 portrait 2:3. Clean crisp intentional seams and edges, refined material highlights, no blur, no low-detail cartoon, no gritty texture, no background scenery, particles, text, logos or watermark.
